blocks.html: In the second place, there are witnesses who were at the wedding of the said Martin and de Rols, and especially one Catherine Boëre, who brought at midnight the collation (which they called the réveil [the midnight visit to the bridal bed with food and drink]), who obstinately assures that it is he who married the said de Rols, and whom she found lying in bed with her. Thirdly, the better part of the witnesses give marks and conjectures that are invincible, to wit, that Martin Guerre had two supernumerary teeth in the upper jaw, a scar on the forehead, the nail of the first finger sunken, three warts on the right hand, another on the little finger, and a drop of blood in the left eye; which marks have all been found on the prisoner.
